name: Canada AIDA/PIPEDA
description: Artificial Intelligence and Data Act (AIDA) and Personal Information Protection and Electronic Documents Act (PIPEDA) - Canadian framework for AI governance and personal data protection

policies.requirement_description: An organization is responsible for personal information under its control. A designated individual shall be accountable for compliance.
Persons responsible for high-impact AI systems must publish plain-language descriptions of the system, its intended uses, and measures to mitigate risks.
The knowledge and consent of the individual are required for the collection, use, or disclosure of personal information, except where inappropriate.

policies.requirement_ref: AIDA Section 8 - Risk assessment and harm mitigation
policies.requirement_description: Persons responsible for high-impact AI systems must establish measures to identify, assess, and mitigate risks of harm or biased output.
